verdict.rationale: Superhuman for Teams shares read statuses across the team and shows when teammates are replying to prevent collisions, which partly covers everyone seeing the same conversation state. A team-comments post describes @mentions and shared live email views, but it is framed as what the best tools do generally, so it is only weak evidence that Superhuman offers them. Missing for 10: an explicit shared-inbox or shared-account feature (e.g., a jointly worked support@ mailbox), clear first-party documentation of team channels or live shared views, and independent or hands-on corroboration of team collaboration.
